events.title: Nebuchadnezzar II captures Jerusalem
events.description: The Babylonian Chronicle records that Nebuchadnezzar took Jerusalem, carried King Jehoiachin into exile and installed Zedekiah. A revolt led to the city's destruction in 587 BCE.
events.html: The Babylonian Chronicle records that Nebuchadnezzar took Jerusalem, carried King Jehoiachin into exile and installed Zedekiah. A revolt led to the city's destruction in 587 BCE.

events.title: Magellan's expedition reaches the Philippines
events.description: After crossing the Pacific, Ferdinand Magellan's ships sighted Samar and landed at Homonhon. Magellan was killed on Mactan in April, but one ship completed the first circumnavigation in 1522.
events.html: After crossing the Pacific, Ferdinand Magellan's ships sighted Samar and landed at Homonhon. Magellan was killed on Mactan in April, but one ship completed the first circumnavigation in 1522.

events.title: Long Parliament dissolves itself
events.description: First summoned in 1640, the Long Parliament voted its own dissolution and called new elections. The Convention Parliament that followed invited Charles II to return as king.
events.html: First summoned in 1640, the Long Parliament voted its own dissolution and called new elections. The Convention Parliament that followed invited Charles II to return as king.

events.title: Congress establishes the US Military Academy at West Point
events.description: President Jefferson signed the act founding a military academy at West Point, New York. Its graduates included Grant, Lee and Eisenhower.
events.html: President Jefferson signed the act founding a military academy at West Point, New York. Its graduates included Grant, Lee and Eisenhower.

events.title: Robert Goddard launches the first liquid-fuelled rocket
events.description: At Auburn, Massachusetts, Goddard's petrol and liquid-oxygen rocket flew for 2.5 seconds and rose about 12 metres. The principle underlies most modern space launch vehicles.
events.html: At Auburn, Massachusetts, Goddard's petrol and liquid-oxygen rocket flew for 2.5 seconds and rose about 12 metres. The principle underlies most modern space launch vehicles.

events.title: Hitler announces German rearmament and conscription
events.description: Defying the Treaty of Versailles, Hitler reintroduced conscription and announced an army of 36 divisions. Britain, France and Italy protested, but took no effective action.
events.html: Defying the Treaty of Versailles, Hitler reintroduced conscription and announced an army of 36 divisions. Britain, France and Italy protested, but took no effective action.

events.title: US soldiers massacre villagers at My Lai
events.description: American troops killed some 350 to 500 unarmed civilians, mostly women, children and old men, in a South Vietnamese hamlet. Exposed in 1969, the massacre deepened opposition to the war.
events.html: American troops killed some 350 to 500 unarmed civilians, mostly women, children and old men, in a South Vietnamese hamlet. Exposed in 1969, the massacre deepened opposition to the war.
